current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether the given list L of 45 distinct positive integers can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for every triple i in {1,...,15}.
IF a valid partition exists, PROVIDE one complete example of such a partition.

current_plan.body:
VALIDATE that the supplied list L contains 45 distinct positive integers
GENERATE the set of all candidate triples (a, b, c) from L such that a + b = c
APPLY a combinatorial selection procedure to choose 15 disjoint triples that together use every element of L exactly once
IF a complete selection exists THEN
PREPARE the chosen 15 triples as the required example partition
ELSE
PREPARE a statement that no valid partition exists
